title: Crestline Companion Phone Booking Fee Refund: Standing Fees and Refund Amount
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the phone booking fee refund of a booking is nothing, as the standing product rule gives it.

## Terms

- **Phone booking fee still standing** on the certificate or pass — all phone booking fee charges on its ledger less all phone booking fee refunds on its ledger, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Phone booking fee refund** — the amount that comes back multiplied by one plus the combined uplift percentage, rounded half up to the cent, and never more than the phone booking fees still standing on the certificate or pass. The uplift percentages are first added into one combined uplift percentage that is applied once.

## Worked figures (hypothetical ledger)

| Phone booking fee charges | Phone booking fee refunds | Still standing | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25.00 | none | 25.00 | nothing (0.00) |
| 25.00 and 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | nothing (0.00) |

**Can the refund exceed what is standing?** No. The refund is never more than the phone booking fees still standing on the certificate or pass.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
